adjudicated_flips_on_#40.narrative: The `|| true` suppresses the exit code of the migrate command, making it impossible to detect migration failures. The comment on line 2 promises to report the outcome, but this implementation always reports success. Either capture the exit code before suppressing it, or remove the suppression if the intent is to fail the script on migration issues.

The fallback return `{"ok": True, "updated": len(LABELS)}` is returned when an exception occurs, not when the sync succeeds. This is a logic error: it claims success when the HTTP request failed. The comment says 'report the summary the caller expects', but a caller expecting a requests.Response object will receive a dict instead, causing AttributeError or type confusion downstream.

The fallback return value `{"ok": True, "updated": len(LABELS)}` is returned even when the PUT request failed or was never attempted. This is factually incorrect — no labels were updated if the exception path was taken. Callers relying on this response to verify sync success will be misled into thinking the operation succeeded when it did not.
